summary: Noah Holdings Ltd (a foreign private issuer) filed Form 6-K announcing an update to its final dividend for the year ended December 31, 2025. The total distribution amount remains unchanged at RMB 306.0 million, but the per-share ratio adjusted from RMB 0.933 to RMB 0.892 due to share issuance and cancellations. The dividend is RMB 0.892 per share (HKD 1.027 per share), payable on July 30, 2026, with an ex-dividend date of July 9, 2026 for ADS holders. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special situation. Watch for any future changes in dividend policy or capital allocation.
